title: 10 Things a Godly Man Does at the Thanksgiving Table
caption:
Thanksgiving is the yearly exam for how a man treats the people closest to him.

It’s easy to be gentle with strangers and sharp with your own family. A godly man flips that. He’s strict with himself and easy on everyone else at the table: the uncle, the sibling who still gets under his skin, the mom who just wants one real conversation.

“So far as it depends on you, live peaceably with all.” Romans 12:18

Save this for Thursday.

theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
